messages:
tess: Heads-up: quota alerts noisier this morning. A bunch of requests attributed to 'project:unknown' for the dedicated pool. Anyone see logs?
kai: I scanned logs. Pattern: requests from our SA-proxy path where header `x-origin-project` is missing post-rotation. Happens when tokens are minted via the new exchange flow.
ops-bot: alert#Q-322 triggered. sample_req=def456 path=/v1/generate model=rwkv-7b
rachel: Is this strictly attribution for quota, or does it affect authz too?
tess: Affects billing dashboards and per-project SLO charts. authz still validates token but the project claim isn't propagated to routing.
ben: I remember a related convo where we switched the claim name from `proj` -> `project_id`. Did the proxy not get the migration?
kai: yes, v1->v2 claim rename in token-introspect. The proxy relies on introspect payload key `project` but the introspect result now returns `project_id`. Token exchange team rolled this out last week.
tess: Oof. Who owns the mapping? We need a short-term shim in auth-proxy to read both keys. Also console-side, we should display 'effective_project' and link to the token's issuance trace.
ops-bot: created ticket #4510 assigned to infra-team.
rachel: UX request: when project unknown, console should show last successful attributed route and time. Helps correlate for customers.
ai: note: add metric auth.project_claim_mismatch with labels {claim_seen, expected_claim}.
ben: quick hotfix plan: deploy header-compat shim in auth-proxy that checks multiple claim names and emits a telemetry event when fallback used. We'll gate the telemetry to prevent noise.
kai: I'll draft PR and unit tests. Canary to staging, then 10% on prod.
tess: also add a console rollout flag so support team can flip to show 'effective_project' column per-route. rachel please file the UX ticket and wire the flag.
rachel: on it. will include CSV export for billing reconciliation.
tess: thanks all. keep updates brief here. if we get customer pings escalate to p0.
ben: PR 6901 open. added compatibility tests for both `proj` and `project_id`. Logs look clean.
kai: deployed to staging. test harness simulating exchange flow shows attribution recovered.
tess: great, schedule canary tonight after low-traffic window.
ops-bot: schedule canary job at 02:00 UTC.
ben: tagging @oncall for awareness.
tess: closing loop later with a postmortem note if we see more spikes.
